A sable blue circlet shimmers with finely woven threads of sparkling white.
This simple band of copper vibrates slightly when handled.
This silvery metal ring seems to momentarily vanish when observed from certain angles.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/treasure.4th-echelon.trin: This ancient wooden lantern is inscribed with eldritch runes and stained with dark blood.
This wide metal bracer is set with a glowing gemstone.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/treasure.1st-echelon.cons: A diamond-shaped dart holds a shimmering black vial at its core.
A gold-rimmed, mirror-faced coin trembles in the hand as if it were repelled by your touch.
This cooling orange salve crackles and pops when exposed to the air.
Thick and red, this liquid tastes of sour beer.
This thick green liquid tastes of licorice and potatoes.
A thumb-sized serrated tooth manages to scratch your flesh in some way whenever it is handled.
A small leather pouch is filled with this fine blue powder.
A densely interlocking sphere of clockwork gears features facets that show the countenance of the item's wielder.
This tiny compact holds a colorless powder with the slightest astringent smell.
A small pot is filled with a viscous, ochre oil that smells of sulfur and burnt hair.
This thin glass sphere holds a tiny roiling cloud.
This delicate orange blossom has a sickly-sweet smell.
A brittle glass tube has a ruby set atop it, attached by a hinge.
The tongue of an imp has been dried and preserved. Yuck.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/treasure.2nd-echelon.cons: A glass flask contains a whirl of gentle sunlight.
Tiny chips of white bone float within this dark potion, which carries the scent of beef broth.
This decadent-looking treat feels strangely heavy in the hand.
This dark, viscous liquid tastes like burnt leaves.
A glass vial holds translucent flakes that twinkle in the light.
This clear, pasty substance has a bitter aroma.
This scroll is marked by sigils of power, death, and life.
A short iron wand shaped of interlocking segments leaks greasy black oil from its joints.
Clear liquid seems to constantly churn within an obsidian vial, even when at rest.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/treasure.3rd-echelon.cons: A cloudy glass vial holds a writhing monstrous grub.
Liquid constantly swirls within a cut glass bottle that is ice cold to the touch.
A card bearing the Eighth City Advocacy Services crest smells faintly of smoke and spices.
This tiny humanoid effigy appears unnervingly lifelike and is always warm to the touch.
This muddy brown whiskey tastes of peat and death.
This spiked crystal makes a beautiful ringing sound when first touched.
This smoothly polished quartz stone feels strangely warm to the touch.
This thick purple liquid has a bitter scent that lingers.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/treasure.4th-echelon.cons: A glass flask holds a roiling storm of astral plasma.
This thick red liquid smells of cinnamon.
This page is covered with writing and diagrams detailing the release of limitless energy—and the dangers of that process.
An ornately decorated golden vial smells of summer rain and subtle zesty fruits.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/treasure.leveled.armor/ad: This suit is shaped of tough leather and set with thousands of tiny barbs on the inside, all thankfully pain-free to the touch.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/treasure.leveled.armor/ch: This set of heavy chain mail is created to allow free movement in extreme environments without sacrificing protection.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/treasure.leveled.armor/gr: The blue-purple carapace and wings of a gigantic scarab beetle have been formed into an ornate breastplate.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/treasure.leveled.armor/ki: A sunmetal kite shield bears the face of a lion on its front, its mouth opening wider over the course of battle.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/treasure.leveled.armor/ku: Each scale of this iridescent armor shimmers with the faint image of a frozen moment of time.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/treasure.leveled.armor/pa: This delicate robe is made from thousands of pages torn from books, intricately folded together without a single thread to bind them.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/treasure.leveled.armor/sh: This midnight-dark leather coat is embossed with fractal patterns that appear different each time they are observed.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/treasure.leveled.armor/sp: This heavy mechanized plate armor of gnomish make is designed to create its own cover on the battlefield.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/treasure.leveled.armor/st: Shimmering light flows like liquid along this suit of crystalline armor.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/treasure.leveled.armor/te: An unseen force seems to draw this steel shield toward nearby creatures.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/treasure.leveled.implemen: An ornate ring is set with a large diamond that swirls with blue light, and whose inner surface is etched with protective runes.
This crystal wand thrums with power, yet is so thin and brittle that it feels as if even a slight squeeze will shatter it.
A perfectly clear sphere is embossed with fine ivory and crystal that is frigid to the touch.
This bronze bottle has been shaped into the form of a ghostly figure.
These spectacles feature pink-tinted glass lenses held in a silver frame.
This ornate high elf tome seems to sigh each time it is opened.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/treasure.leveled.weapon/a: This long, sinuous chain is composed entirely of broken links held together by unseen power.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/treasure.leveled.weapon/b: This crystal blade houses a stormy vortex of fire, ice, and lightning.
Despite sporting an outrageously ornate hilt adorned with far too many jewels, this blade remains perfectly balanced.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/treasure.leveled.weapon/d: This crystal battleaxe seems to pull at the hands that wield it, as if anxious to leap across the battlefield.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/treasure.leveled.weapon/e: This blade exudes a faint hum that grows louder as its quarry weakens.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/treasure.leveled.weapon/i: The head of this iron hammer is cold to the touch and encases whatever it strikes in a thin layer of ice.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/treasure.leveled.weapon/k: This ivory dagger features nine faintly glowing indentations along the blade.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/treasure.leveled.weapon/l: This needlelike lance is cast of shimmering metal and induces a yearning for the skies in those who handle it.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/treasure.leveled.weapon/m: This flexible black-iron net burns with the heat of a volcano.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/treasure.leveled.weapon/o: This mechanized bow is set with magical reservoirs that carry the faint tang of toxins.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/treasure.leveled.weapon/s: This sinuous whip reflects all light off its plated steel surfaces.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/treasure.leveled.weapon/t: The shifting patterns on this bow's crystalline grip resemble dozens of blinking eyes.
This bident is made from two pieces of moon metal twisted together, and hums like a tuning fork.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/treasure.leveled.weapon/w: When first held, this naginata whispers the names of its past victims.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/treasure.leveled.other/bl: This ring appears to be traced by dried blood, which returns each time it is rubbed away.
These rough hand wraps are stained with blood that never comes clean.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/treasure.leveled.other/li: Sparks strike from these boots whenever they touch the ground, increasing in number as the wearer gathers speed.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/treasure.leveled.other/re: When first handled, this tattered cloak fills the mind with thoughts of revenge.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/treasure.leveled.other/th: This burnished copper torque thrums with a sense of judgment.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/ancient-loremaster: It's astonishing what you find in old books. Look at this—nearly complete schematics for a war automaton, gathering dust because nobody here reads Zaliac.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/battleaxe-diplomat: We seem to be equals in might and combat prowess. Perhaps we should bandy words awhile instead.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/brawler: We won't kill you. But you might wish we had.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/city-rat: Stay out all night, visit the dives. Get in a fight, run from the cops. That's the real city.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/doomed: I don't know what it meant, but when I watched her die, I saw a vision. I watched her die and saw my own death. Am I losing my mind?
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/dwarven-legionnaire: I have learned much. It might be your courage that inspires others. Watch your opponent's shield as well as their sword. And above all, stand fast, and do not yield.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/elemental-dabbler: Spirit of fire, I command you!
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/faction-member: In six months, I'll be running this place.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/local-hero: Your coin won't spend here. The Heroes of Gravesford drink for free in this tavern!
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/mage-hunter: Their power is dangerous. Unnatural. Someone needs to do something.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/marshal: I said you had twenty-four hours to leave town. That was... what, about twenty-four hours ago?
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/monster-bane: You dare mock Blunwin Mousebane? You think my deed trivial? Ah, but you didn't see the size of the mouse!
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/owed-a-favor: The Guild's gratitude knows no bounds! We'll repay you in any way we can... short of actually paying you.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/presumed-dead: But... you're dead. We went to your funeral.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/ratcatcher: I like fighting these little guys. Means I don't have to waste money on a helmet.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/saved-for-a-worse-f: Drink this. You'll need all your strength for what lies ahead!
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/ship-captain: Up anchor, shipmates! 'Tisn't gold but glory we seek!
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/troupe-leading-play: We're actors! We're the opposite of people!
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/wanted-dead-or-aliv: A hundred silver?! An insult! I turned my father in for fifty golden crowns. And he was innocent!
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/zombie-slayer: Why won't you die?! You've already done it once, you should be good at it by now!
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/arena-fighter: You've never seen the showstopper? The move so brutal it was banned in the arena? Come closer and I'll show it to you.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/awakened: I was grappling with them, and when they died... I felt something happen. To me.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/battlefield-command: Spells and shadows have their place, but it takes soldiers to hold the field.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/blood-magic: Flow, blood, thou fiend's libation, and catch my foes in conflagration!
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/corsair: Haul down your flag or we'll burn you to the waterline!
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/faction-officer: If you want or need something, talk to me. I have a certain... influence in these parts.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/fey-friend: Do you enjoy the vintage? Yes, you can understand my tongue now. One does not drink at my table and leave unchanged.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/giant-slayer: Come back here, puny one, and let me crush you!
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/godsworn: He seemed like he needed help! Now the dead speak to me. I think maybe that old man was more than he appeared.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/heist-hero: Everybody know their assignments? All right, let's go.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/knight: Kneel, heroes. Arise, knights of Tor, and may your swords be ever sharp in our service.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/master-librarian: You want to know the exact coordinates of the Gem of the Waves shipwreck? I came across that just the other day in an unpublished memoir of its second mate. Let me get that for…
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/special-agent: And this is interesting... if you twist the third button on your overcoat no, don't do it now!
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/sworn-hunter: I will follow you to the ends of the earth—just so I can kick you off the edge.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/undead-slain: No, I didn't get bitten. And yes, I'm fine!
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/unstoppable: I seen the goblin king run 'im through with a spear. Then I seen 'im pull 'imself back up, spear still in 'im, and headbutt the goblin king... then he pulls out the spear and…
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/armed-and-dangerous: I'm not picky. Any tool will suffice. A sword seems a most appropriate tool for this job.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/dragon-blooded: I stabbed the wyrm Axarthan in the heart and their silver blood washed over me, leaving me... as you see.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/maestro: When I saw the bloodstained manuscript under Fellwander's arm, I knew his quest for the Opera was over—and with it, his chance for redemption.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/master-crafter: The sword Vanartha has been remade, mightier now than on the day it was forged.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/noble: Technically, I'm called Lord Morninghill these days. I did a little favor for Duke Kenway at the Battle of Black Forest.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/planar-voyager: I've seen skywhales floating above the seas of Primordius. I've seen star freighters dancing around the moons of Axiom. So I guess you're right, I'm not from around these parts.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/scarred: Last time we fought, I gave you a little token to remember me by... now it appears you need another reminder of my power.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/siege-breaker: Best way to deal with a castle siege? Be on the outside.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/teacher: Someday, I'll understand how peeling these carrots for dinner relates to my elementalist training.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/champion-competitor: Marduk uses the Beldoit Gambit! Avanna counters with the Iron Defense and goes on the attack! Marduk's last tower is knocked down! And just like that, we have a new... world...…
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/demigod: The ritual is complete. I feel your power flow through me. I am become a god! Ah-ha-ha-ha-ha!
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/enlightened: Don't you see? This world that seems so real to you is nothing but a game, and all the people merely pieces!
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/forsaken: The quest is done, the enemy is defeated, and the Blade of a Thousand Years has passed from our hands. What do we do with the rest of our lives?
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/monarch: The tyrant is dead! Long live the new king!
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/peace-bringer: There goes Diana, peace bringer. She has won many a victory with her sword, but her greatest deed was convincing two nations to stop fighting.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/reborn: I remember this world. I suppose my task is not yet complete.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/theoretical-warrior: I've read about this tactic in books—it looks fairly straightforward.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/tireless: To reach Giant's Foot by dawn, we'll have to run every step of the way. Let's get moving.
summaries.mcdm.heroes.v1/title/unchained: I'll never get away with it? My dear, I already have.
summaries.0414: Created for the Last Myth campaign, tauros, also called minotaurs, descend from demons who emerged during the Infernal Breach. Their ancestors retained their minds despite the…
summaries.0415: Created for the Last Myth campaign, lizardfolk are small, dragonlike creatures. They descend from the great true dragons the gods wiped out in an ancient war.
